name: Camp Kosh
summary: At Camp Kosh, Dustbelcher ogres prey on caravans crossing the northern Badlands. They scavenge abandoned gear from roads leading toward Kargath and the Searing Gorge.

sections.title: A Den of Scavengers
sections.body: In the northern Badlands, Dustbelcher ogres make their northernmost camp at Camp Kosh. Their tribe also holds nearby camps called Boff, Cagg, and Wurg. From these camps, they strike vulnerable supply lines bound for Kargath or traveling west into the Searing Gorge. When dwarven prospectors led by Sigrun Ironhew fled the excavation at Uldaman, the ogres raided their abandoned wagons. They carried food rations and weapons back into Camp Kosh.

faq.answer: Dustbelcher ogres live in Camp Kosh, one of several small camps their tribe holds across the Badlands.

faq.q: Why is Camp Kosh located here?
faq.answer: From Camp Kosh in the northern Badlands, Dustbelcher ogres can ambush supply caravans and unwary travelers heading toward the Searing Gorge or Kargath.

faq.q: What did the ogres steal from the dwarves?
faq.answer: When Sigrun Ironhew's dwarven expedition fled Uldaman, they left supply wagons behind in the desert. Camp Kosh's ogres scavenged crates of food and weapons from them.

angles.text: Sigrun Ironhew's dwarven expedition left rations and weapons behind when it fled Uldaman. Camp Kosh's ogres took them.
Alliance scouts on the northern route toward the Searing Gorge must watch for Camp Kosh's ogres. They ambush passing supply caravans.
